visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at Kaohsiung International Airport, where a young man with black hair, wearing a black mask and a black T-shirt, is the central focus. He holds a green Republic of China passport and a boarding pass in front of a brightly lit terminal background with various travel banners and check-in signs. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of the travel documents being processed by staff, followed by a view from inside an airplane cockpit showing pilots at the controls. Then, a shot from the passenger window captures a vast blue ocean under a bright sky filled with white, fluffy clouds. (3) Upon arrival at Hong Kong Disneyland, the man is seen standing before a decorative Mickey Mouse floral hedge and the '20' anniversary logo at the entrance. The lighting is warm natural daylight, and numerous tourists are visible in the blurred background. (4) As night falls, the man participates in park activities, including watching a vibrant fireworks display at the castle. He is shown wearing 3D glasses inside a ride with high-contrast red and blue cinematic lighting, with other passengers visible in the seats behind him. (5) The final sequence includes still photographs of the man and his friends smiling while wearing character-themed headbands like Minnie Mouse and Donald Duck inside a room. The video ends with a short, isolated clip of a person in a monkey king costume indoors, looking directly at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-tempo electronic pop beat featuring a bright synth melody and a driving percussion pattern. A clear female vocal sings in English, establishing an energetic and joyful mood for the airport and travel montage. (2) A subtle acoustic shift occurs as a low-frequency hum of an airplane engine is introduced, suggesting flight. The BGM remains dominant, but the environmental roar adds a layer of realism to the cockpit and sky visuals. (3) A male voice enters with high emotional arousal, exclaiming 'tài měng le ba zhè ge' (太猛了吧這個) in a sharp, excited tone. This vocal event marks a transition as the traveler experiences the sights of Hong Kong Disneyland. (4) The music transitions into a percussive, rhythmic 'Days of the Week' song with bright melodic textures. This is accompanied by the loud, sharp cracks and deep booms of fireworks, providing high-intensity auditory peaks that synchronize with the pyrotechnic flashes. (5) The final phase features a hard cut to a comedic clip where a male voice says 'fán sǐ le' (煩死了) with exaggerated, theatrical frustration and a higher pitch. This vocal outburst is captured with room resonance, followed by a sudden, clean termination of all audio signals.
